content: The Reuters Corpus Volume I (RCV1) is corpus containing 806,791 news articles in the English language collected from 20/08/1996 to 19/08/1997 BIBREF31 . The topic of each news was human-annotated using a hierarchical structure. At the top of the hierarchy, lies the coarse-grained categories: CCAT (Corporate), ECAT (Economics), GCAT (Government), and MCAT (Markets). A news article can be assigned to more than one category meaning that the text categorization task is mutilabel. Each news is stored in a separate XML file. lst:rcv1xmlexample shows the typical structure of an article.
